notes.title: Big Update
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay[/b]
A new mechanic was implemented “Opportunities”, improving the second ball plays and making the game more dynamic.
More freedom of movement for the players
Faster sets plays in hard mode
Levantamentos mais rápidos no modo hard
Some AI improvements

[b]Animations[/b]
The animations were all redone from the scratch using new techniques
(Although they got only a little better)

[b]Languages[/b]
Official French support has been added
Partial translation were added (tutorial e main menus) in these languages:
Simplified Chinese, Japanese, German, Turkish, Russian, Italian

[b]Bugs fixed[/b]
AI ball distribution
Inverted celebrations when in the opponent’s errors
Bug where special codes were saved for multiple matches

[b]Other small improvements[/b]
Camera moviment
Extras sounds
Graphical changes to some assets
Achievements were made easier
Scoreboard options for faster matches
Increased HUD size to play in smaller screens (but I have no idea if the game runs on steamdeck)

notes.title: Fix some bugs and a new player
notes.content:
New character to choose for your setter

Bugs
fixed the possibility of getting stuck in photo mode
fixed the problem of sets of the thirteenth team in hard mode
fixed libero entering the court to save the ball (as seventh player) 
removed a glitch that facilitated triple block
prevent system messages from appearing on the screen

Others things like small changes on gameplay, passwords and IAs

notes.title: 2020 Olympic Games Atualization
notes.content:
Improvements were made in the game for those who want enjoy a game related to the olympic games

This update was focused on making the game simpler and easier to learn to play
for those who have difficulties with this before, I recommend trying again

[b]Gameplay updates[/b]
The block system has been changed to a system more common and more forgiving with errors
The restriction of having to press the button way before the 'set' was removed, now just need to press before the contact with the ball
The accuracy of the serves has been slightly improved
Reduction of AI errors in hard mode

[b]Tutorial updates[/b]
I kept the tutorial small but explained some parts better
Tips were added during the serve

[b]Demo Version updates[/b]
The Demo Version was updated to the same version of the game
also was added the possibility of playing for more time, in case the player still having some difficulty in the game

[b]Custom Teams updates[/b]
Now when creating a new team the players already are created with full status
Possibility for take an official photo included

[b]Bugs[/b]
An error where the game continues for a little time after the block has been fixed, this sometimes invalidated the result of the game at the end (I think)
Adjustments in the reception position have been limited to avoid errors in the animation

Some other things have small changes like sounds, animations, cameras and etc
